Founders' Office Associate – Government, Partnerships and Product

Ananant Systems | Noida | Full-time | Regular travel within India | Reports to the CEO

Ananant is hiring a Founders' Office Associate to own government programmes, partnerships, product input, contracts and marketing, working directly with the CEO and CTO.

ABOUT ANANANT

Ananant Systems is an Indian deep-tech semiconductor company. We design chips for small-cell 4G/5G and camera applications, with teams in Bengaluru, Noida and San Diego. We are backed by venture capital and by national semiconductor programmes, and we are growing several-fold over the next 18 months.

THE ROLE

Outside engineering, Ananant depends on three things: the government programmes it wins, the customers and partners who adopt its chips, and its standing in the market. This role owns all three.

You will work directly with the CEO and CTO. You represent Ananant to government, partners and customers, and bring what you learn from them back into the company.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Government programmes. Identify, apply for and deliver government semiconductor and R&D programmes: applications, milestones, reporting and compliance, and the working relationship with the ministries and agencies involved.

• Partnerships and lead customers. Build and manage the pipeline of strategic partners and lead customers, and track every commitment made to them.

• Product and market. Bring customer requirements, market information and competitive analysis into product decisions, and build the business case for new opportunities.

• Contracts. Manage customer, partner, vendor and government agreements through review, approval and signature, working with our law firm. Maintain the contract register, renewals and obligations.

• Marketing. Own positioning, collateral, the website and our presence at industry events.

WHAT YOU WILL DELIVER

Expected outcomes in the first year:

• Government programmes won, with every report and milestone under them delivered on time.

• Partnerships signed and lead customers evaluating our chips.

• Customer and market input feeding product decisions on a regular basis.

• A complete and current contract register, with no missed renewals or obligations.

• Consistent positioning and collateral in use with customers, partners and government.

WHY THIS ROLE

• Scope. Government, customers, product, contracts and marketing in one role, each being set up for the first time.

• Direct access. You work with the CEO and CTO directly, on decisions that matter to the company.

• Sector exposure. You will build relationships and expertise across Indian semiconductor policy, customers and partners.

• A path to leadership. The role is expected to grow into leading a function as the company scales.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

1 to 5 years of experience. Comfortable both in meetings with senior government officials and partners, and in building financial models. Clear writer, strong with numbers, and able to run work end to end with limited supervision.

You bring:

• Strong Excel modelling and a solid grasp of business financials: P&L, cash flow, budgets and unit economics.

• Working knowledge of compliance and audits.

• Clear, persuasive writing and presentation for formal audiences.

• Daily, hands-on use of AI tools.

• Ability to represent the company with senior officials, partners and customers.

It helps if you have:

• An MBA, ideally with a consulting background.

• Founder or early-stage startup experience.

• An engineering degree, or experience in semiconductors, telecom or deep tech.

• Experience with Indian government programmes, public-sector stakeholders, or commercial contracts.

HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV and a short note on something you built or ran end to end, and what you would do differently. The process is a conversation with the CEO, a short work sample on a problem from the role, and a review with the founders. It takes about two weeks.

title: Responsible AI & Governance
description:
Role Overview

The Office of Responsible AI within Digital Foundation Services is looking for a practitioner who can hold both halves of the job at once: the engineering depth to take an agentic AI system apart and see how it actually behaves, and the governance fluency to judge whether it should be allowed to run. This is not a policy-only role, and it is not a pure engineering role. The person we are looking for reviews architectures, reads evaluation results, challenges design choices, and then turns those findings into control decisions that clients, delivery teams and regulators can rely on.

The role works across delivery teams shipping agentic and generative AI into production for enterprise customers. Day to day the work spans risk assessment of new AI use cases, hands-on review of model and retrieval pipelines, definition of guardrails and evaluation criteria, and enablement of engineering teams so that responsible AI practice is built in rather than inspected in at the end.

Key Responsibilities

Governance and assurance

* Run intake and risk classification for new AI and agentic use cases, applying an agreed risk-tiering method and recording the rationale, so decisions remain auditable.
* Own the responsible AI control framework — policies, standards, checklists and approval gates — and keep it aligned to EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 expectations.
* Chair or support the AI review board: prepare evidence packs, present findings, and track conditions of approval through closure.
* Maintain the AI inventory and model registry, covering ownership, data lineage, intended use and residual risk for every deployed system.
* Produce audit-ready documentation: model cards, system cards, data sheets, impact assessments, and evaluation reports.

Technical assurance of AI systems

* Review agentic architectures end to end: tool and function calling, planning loops, memory, autonomy boundaries, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and failure containment.
* Assess retrieval-augmented generation pipelines for grounding quality, chunking and embedding choices, retrieval relevance, citation fidelity and leakage of restricted content.
* Evaluate fine-tuned and adapted models for fitness of purpose, drift, catastrophic forgetting, and the provenance and licensing of training data.
* Design and oversee evaluation of harnesses covering accuracy, robustness, bias, toxicity, prompt injection, jailbreak resistance and data exfiltration.
* Define guardrail patterns — input and output filtering, policy engines, tool sandboxing, scope and rate limits — and validate that they hold under adversarial testing.

Enablement and advisory

* Advise solution architects and delivery lead at design time, so controls are chosen early rather than retrofitted late.
* Build and run enablement material: playbooks, reference patterns, training and office hours for the engineering and delivery communities.
* Act as escalation point for AI incidents, running root-cause analysis and feeding lessons back into the control framework.
* Support client conversations and bid responses where responsible AI posture is a differentiator or a contractual requirement.

Technical Skills Required

Agentic AI frameworks and tooling

* Working knowledge of at least two agentic frameworks — LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel or the OpenAI Agents SDK — including their orchestration and state models.
* Familiarity with agent interoperability and tool-integration standards, including Model Context Protocol and comparable function-calling interfaces.
* Practical experience with multi-agent patterns such as planner-executor, supervisor-worker and reflection loops, and with the failure modes each introduces.
* Ability to read production agent code and execution traces, and to instrument systems with observability tooling such as LangSmith, Langfuse or OpenTelemetry.

Models, fine-tuning and RAG

* Solid grounding in transformer architectures, tokenization, context windows, decoding parameters and the practical limits of current frontier and open-weight models.
* Hands-on understanding of adaptation techniques — prompt engineering, instruction tuning, LoRA and QLoRA, full fine-tuning, RLHF and preference optimization — and when each is appropriate.
* Experience building or reviewing RAG systems: embedding models, vector stores such as FAISS, Azure AI Search, Pinecone or pgvector, hybrid and re-ranked retrieval, and evaluation of grounding quality.
* Comfort with evaluation tooling and benchmarks, including LLM-as-judge techniques and a clear view of their known weaknesses.
* Awareness of cost, latency and sustainability trade-offs across hosted and self-hosted deployment options.

Engineering foundations

* Python at a level sufficient to prototype, read production code and build evaluation scripts.
* Familiarity with at least one major cloud AI platform — Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI — and its native governance and content-safety controls.
* Understanding of MLOps and LLMOps practice: CI/CD, versioning, monitoring, rollback and change control for models and prompts.
* Working knowledge of security and privacy fundamentals as they apply to AI: identity, secrets, data classification, anonymization and residency.

AI Governance and Responsible AI Expertise

* Practical command of the EU AI Act, including risk tiering, general-purpose AI obligations and conformity expectations, with the ability to translate them into engineering controls.
* Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and ISO/IEC 23894, and experience operationalizing at least one of them.
* Understanding of sector regulation relevant to financial services and other regulated industries, including model risk management expectations such as SR 11-7.
* Knowledge of data protection regimes such as GDPR and the DPDP Act, and how they interact with training data, inference logs and cross-border transfer.
* Fluency in fairness, explainability, transparency and accountability techniques, with the judgement to select the right one rather than defaulting to a favorite.
* Experience running AI impact assessments and third-party or vendor AI risk reviews.
* Awareness of emerging assurance practice: red teaming, model evaluation standards, content provenance and watermarking.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies

This role only works if the person can carry a technical argument into a business room and be believed in both. The behaviours below carry as much weight in selection as the technical depth above.

* Influence without authority. Much of the job is persuading teams that do not report to you to change a design, which takes credibility, patience and a workable alternative rather than a veto.
* Clear communication across levels. The same finding must be expressed as an engineering ticket, a client-facing paragraph and a board-level risk statement without losing accuracy at any step.
* Constructive challenge. Comfortable saying no to a senior stakeholder, and equally comfortable saying yes quickly when the risk is genuinely low; proportionality matters more than caution.
* Judgement under ambiguity. Regulation, tooling and model behaviour are all moving. Strong candidates make defensible decisions on incomplete information and revisit them as evidence changes.
* Intellectual honesty. Willing to state the limits of an evaluation, flag their own uncertainty, and correct a published position when new evidence arrives.
* Cross-functional collaboration. Works naturally with legal, privacy, security, procurement, HR and delivery, and can translate between their vocabularies.
* Ethical grounding and empathy. Genuinely considers the people affected by an AI system, including those who are not the paying customer.
* Pragmatism and delivery focus. Understands commercial pressure and designs controls teams can actually adopt, rather than an ideal framework nobody follows.
* Facilitation and coaching. Runs review boards, workshops and enablement sessions that leave people clearer than they arrived.
* Continuous learning. Keeps current with research, incidents and regulatory movement, and shares that knowledge rather than hoarding it.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, data science, engineering or a related quantitative discipline; a law, policy or ethics background combined with demonstrable technical depth will also be considered.
* Eight to twelve years of overall technology experience, including at least three years working directly on machine learning or generative AI systems.
* At least two years in an AI governance, model risk, AI assurance or responsible AI capacity, or equivalent evidence of leading such work from inside an engineering team.
* Demonstrable experience taking at least one generative or agentic AI system from design through to governed production deployment.
* Client-facing or consulting experience is an advantage, given the role's exposure to customer, audit and regulator conversations.

Preferred Certifications and Credentials

* IAPP AI Governance Professional (AIGP).
* ISO/IEC 42001 lead implementer or lead auditor.
* A cloud AI engineering certification such as Azure AI Engineer Associate, AWS Machine Learning Specialty or Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer.
* Security or privacy credentials such as CISSP, CIPP/E or CIPM.
* Published work, open-source contributions or conference talks on responsible AI, model evaluation or agent safety.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year

* Every in-flight AI and agentic use case is classified, inventoried and mapped to a control set with a named owner.
* A documented, repeatable review gate exists and is used by delivery teams without escalation in the majority of cases.
* Evaluation and red-teaming harnesses run automatically against production agent workloads, with results visible to engineering leadership.
* Delivery teams arrive at the review board with evidence already prepared, because the enablement material made the expectations obvious.

title: Senior Manager – Labour Compliance & Governance
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 India's labour law landscape is undergoing its most significant transformation in decades. The consolidation of over 40 central statutes into four Labour Codes is reshaping how enterprises manage workforce compliance — and GE Vernova needs a senior leader who can build the frameworks to get it right.
   

  

 As the Labour Compliance Leader, you will own enterprise\-wide implementation of the four Labour Codes across a complex, multi\-site organization spanning corporate offices, manufacturing plants, and project sites across India. You will design the governance infrastructure, lead the audits, shape the policies, and be the authoritative voice that helps business and HR leaders navigate India's evolving statutory landscape with confidence.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact senior role for someone who brings deep expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to influence across all levels of the organization.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What You'll Do**
* Lead enterprise Labour Code implementation — own compliance readiness across all business units, establish governance controls and monitoring frameworks, drive closure of implementation gaps through structured action plans, and advance the digitization of labour compliance processes.
* Own the compliance calendar and audit function — develop and manage the statutory filings, returns, renewals, and amendment schedule; lead labour audits; coordinate with labour inspectors, auditors, and government authorities; and ensure timely resolution of audit findings.
* Govern contractor and vendor compliance — oversee the statutory compliance of manpower contractors and vendors across factories and project sites, conduct periodic audits, and enforce corrective actions where required.
* Support labour and employee relations — liaise with Office Labour Governance, People Operations, Project Site Managers, and Factory Labour Relations teams; support resolution of labour disputes and inspections; and represent the organization in labour hearings, conciliation proceedings, and government inspections.
* Design and standardize compliance policy — develop labour compliance Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, and frameworks; standardize processes across all operating environments; and serve as a subject matter expert for leadership decision\-making on compliance matters.
* Enable capability across the organization — conduct regular training for HR professionals, site leaders, factory managers, and contractors on applicable labour laws, new Labour Codes, and compliance obligations.


**Who You Are**
 You are a seasoned labour law and compliance professional with deep knowledge of India's Central and State statutory frameworks, and hands\-on experience operating across multi\-site, complex industrial environments.
   

  

**Required**
* A formal education and subsequent Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law (LLB), Human Resources (HR), Industrial Relations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in labour law compliance, industrial relations, and statutory compliance within manufacturing, infrastructure, engineering, construction, or project\-based organizations.
* Proven track record implementing and managing compliance under Central and State Labour Laws, including the new Labour Codes.
* Hands\-on experience managing compliance across corporate offices, manufacturing plants, and project sites.
* Demonstrated experience handling labour inspections, statutory audits, government authorities, and legal proceedings.
* Solid experience in contractor and vendor compliance management.
* Strong working knowledge of the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, Factories Act, Industrial Relations Code, Social Security Code, Occupational Safety Health and Working Conditions (OSHWC) Code, and Wage Code.
* Familiarity with compliance management systems, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS), and standard productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Office).


**Preferred**
* Master's degree in HR, Industrial Relations, Labour Welfare (MLW), Personnel Management, or an MBA in HR.
* Professional certifications in Labour Laws, Industrial Relations, Compliance Management, or Occupational Health and Safety.

**Purpose of the role**
 The role ensures the Group and its subsidiaries meet their tax obligations accurately and on time, carry no unmanaged tax exposure and are structured tax\-efficiently. It is a specialist advisory and oversight role: the holder owns Group tax and transfer\-pricing policy, directs the external regional tax advisors and reviews the tax position of the business. It does not carry responsibility for accounting operations, headcount or compensation, which sit elsewhere in Finance.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Policy and transfer pricing**
* Tax and TP policy. Own the Group tax policy and the related intercompany transfer\-pricing policy, keeping both current and enforced across all entities
* Contract review. Review and approve incoming contracts for tax cost and for the correct PIPECARE contracting entity, before award


**Compliance and oversight**
* Group compliance. Ensure compliance in all operating countries, EMEA, India, the USA and the Americas, across corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax and transfer pricing, on time and accurately
* Direct the advisors. Coordinate and hold accountable the external regional tax advisors, auditors and authorities in each jurisdiction, owning the quality and timeliness of their output
* Filings. Prepare and review tax filings, documentation and reports across the Group, and ensure accurate tax accounting and reconciliation under IFRS and local GAAP
* Internal tax assurance. Provide assurance that the Group and its subsidiaries carry no undisclosed tax liabilities, with particular attention to permanent\-establishment risk on cross\-border work


**Planning, risk and change**
* Planning and optimization. Advise management on international tax planning, structuring and optimization, and manage the tax budget against available reliefs and returns across jurisdictions
* Cross\-border risk. Review cross\-border transactions to identify tax risk and recommend solutions
* Transactions and restructuring. Support M\&A, restructuring, entity wind\-downs and expansion with tax due diligence and planning
* Legislative watch. Monitor changes in international and local tax law, assess the impact on the Group, and adjust policy accordingly
* Guidance. Advise and train the finance teams on tax compliance and policy updates

* Qualification. Chartered Accountant (ICAI), CPA, CTA or equivalent, with a specialization in international tax. A Master's in tax background is an advantage
* Experience. At least 8 to 10 years in international or regional tax, within a multinational group, with a demonstrated record of owning group tax and transfer\-pricing policy independently, not supporting it
* Technical depth. Strong command of international tax treaties, BEPS, transfer pricing, permanent\-establishment risk and indirect tax. Working knowledge of GCC corporate tax and VAT, and of India tax, is a strong advantage
* Multi\-jurisdiction reach. Proven experience across EMEA, India and the Americas, coordinating external advisors in multiple countries
* Independence and judgement. Able to own the Group tax position, challenge advisors and business alike and give the CFO a clear view of risk and options
* Language. Fluent, precise English, written and spoken
* Proactive, the kind of adviser who brings the CFO the risk and the recommended solution together
